# KFCD pingyam Yale source

KFCD (開放詞典), *pingyam*, commit d0ceb32c2da07d156db99e50b192aaf45236ca95.
Original repository: https://github.com/kfcd/pingyam
Original conversion table: https://github.com/kfcd/pingyam/blob/d0ceb32c2da07d156db99e50b192aaf45236ca95/pingyambiu
The original README and LICENSE are retained unchanged. The publisher grants
Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported; full terms are retained beside them
and at https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/ .

This project's transformation compares the table's numeric Yale column 0 with
Jyutping column 6, removes only their explicit terminal tone, and selects six
literal alternative spellings (deeu, eeu, meeu, peeu, seeu, jeeu) plus the literal
hm/hng extension attestations. Existing primary routes remain. The table is
spelling evidence, not dictionary frequency, an inventory of all attested words,
or independent pronunciation approval. No low-register h or diacritic input
conversion is inferred. The original source files are unmodified; mapping
selection and runtime implementation are this project's changes. Preserve
attribution, original license, full terms and this change notice in derivatives.
No KFCD endorsement is implied.
